info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Snapshot Access API

params.name: snapshotId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target snapshot.
**Example:** `startingorganization-xzgbf5rdaiqtaznvh74zdwcedi`

params.name: snapshotAccessType
params.description:
The resource access level to verify.
**Allowed values:**
- `READ`
- `WRITE`

items.docs:
Shows whether the authenticated user has the specified access level (i.e., read or write) to the content of the target snapshot.
**Required privilege:** `Snapshot - View`

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"SNAPSHOTS","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```

items.docs:
Shows whether the authenticated user has the specified access level (i.e., read or write) to the content of the snapshot and returns a list of missing privileges.
**Required privilege:** `Snapshot - View`

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"SNAPSHOTS","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```

Lists the resources that the authenticated user can leverage in snapshots in the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Required privilege:** `Snapshot - Edit`

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"SNAPSHOTS","type":"CREATE","targetId":"*"} ```
